statement_repair: The informal proof proposed encoding the domain as Fin n → ℝ and building IsPolynomialMap using MvPolynomial. Mathlib lacks calculus infrastructure for MvPolynomial.eval, so the informal proof's approach of proving polynomial ⟹ C¹ ⟹ Lipschitz was impractical. Instead, the structural repair uses Mathlib's addHaar_image_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn_of_addHaar_eq_zero (Gouëzel's Jacobian/change-of-variables theory), which directly proves that Differentiable maps on finite-dimensional spaces send null sets to null sets. The polynomial ⟹ Differentiable step is bridged by MvPolynomial.eval_differentiable, proven using eval_eq' (expressing eval as a finite sum of monomial products) and fun_prop.
